is_aqir.name: Aqir
is_aqir.description:
Species Trait: Infection

Active when there are at least (N) different Aqir chess pieces on the chessboard. (Multiple effects stack)

(2) Aqirs: Grants all non-Aqir allies: Upon death, if there is any Infected friendly piece of the same name on the chessboard, immediately hatches a random Aqir piece.
(4) Aqirs: Rank 1 effect now also applies to all friendly Aqir pieces, and will hatch a random higher-level Aqir piece.

Species Trait: Infection

Active when there are at least (N) different Aqir chess pieces on the chessboard. (Multiple effects stack)

(2) Aqirs: Grants all non-Aqir allies: Upon death, if there is any Infected friendly piece of the same name on the chessboard, immediately hatches a random Aqir piece.

is_aqir.lore: From time to time, the Aqirs dwelled on and beneath the ancient land of Drodo Island. Though most of their powers are sealed by the holy Gods, remained powers from the insanity within the Aqir blood draws their insectoid instinct to reside on the flesh of other creatures.
notes: Aqirs do not infect on chess pieces with a expiration duration.

The higher the level of the infected friendly chess piece, the higher the level of the summoned Aqir piece.Rank 1 effect summons the same-level piece as the dying chess piece. Rank 2 summons a chess piece that can be 1 level higher than the dying chess piece, randomly.

Species Trait: Infection

Активно когда у вас есть (N) разных Aqir фигур на столе. (Эффекты складываются)

(2) Aqirs: дает всем союзным не-Aqir: при смерти, если на поле есть заражённый союзник с тем же именем, немедленно вылупляется случайная фигура Aqir.

descriptions.zh-cn:
种族技能：感染

需要己方场上有至少（N）个不同的此种族的棋子来触发效果（触发的多层效果可以叠加）。

（2）虫：使所有非虫族友方棋子获得亡语：如果场上有与它同名的被感染的友方棋子存活，原地孵化一只随机虫族棋子。
（4）虫：使所有友方虫族棋子也获得该亡语，并且孵化的虫族棋子更加强壮。
descriptions.zh-tw:
種族技能：感染

需要己方場上有至少（N）個不同的此種族的棋子來觸發效果（觸發的多層效果可以疊加）。

（2）蟲：使所有非蟲族友方棋子獲得亡語：如果場上有與它同名的被感染的友方棋子存活，原地孵化一只隨機蟲族棋子。
（4）蟲：使所有友方蟲族棋子也獲得該亡語，並且孵化的蟲族棋子更加強壯。

lore_i18n.en: From time to time, the Aqirs dwelled on and beneath the ancient land of Drodo Island. Though most of their powers are sealed by the holy Gods, remained powers from the insanity within the Aqir blood draws their insectoid instinct to reside on the flesh of other creatures.
lore_i18n.ru: Время от времени Акиры обитали на древней земле Острова Дродо и под ней. Хотя большинство их сил запечатаны святыми богами, оставшиеся силы, вызванные безумием в их крови, побуждают их насекомоподобный инстинкт интересоваться, как же они работают.
lore_i18n.zh-cn: 作为上古时代就存在多多岛的异形生物，亚基虫族早已褪去了克克帝国的辉煌。现在它们分成了不同的部族，被封印在地下世界，或者寄生在别的物种体内。
lore_i18n.zh-tw: 作為上古時代就存在多多島的異形生物，亞基蟲族早已褪去了克克帝國的輝煌。現在它們分成了不同的部族，被封印在地下世界，或者寄生在別的物種體內。

is_assassin.name: Assassin
is_assassin.description:
The first movement of Assassin pieces in each round causes Assassins to leap over to the back of the enemy lineup. The first blow after Backstab Leap is always a critical strike with a random bonus damage amplifier.

Class Perk: Coup de Grace

Active when you have at least (N) different Assassin pieces on board. (Multiple effects stack)

(3) Assassins: All friendly assassins have 15% chance to critical hit for 300% damage.
(6) Assassins: All assassins have 15% chance to critical hit for 400% damage.
(9) Assassins: All assassins refresh a Backstab Leap move after killing an enemy or a certain duration. This Backstab Leap always deals the maximum possible critical damage.

職業技能：無中生有

需要己方場上有至少（N）個不同的此職業的棋子來觸發效果（觸發的多層效果可以疊加）。

（2）巫師：在戰鬥回合使需要（4）個及以上棋子的種族/職業技能觸發所需要的棋子數-1。
（4）巫師：如果你只觸發了唯一一個的非巫師的種族/職業技能，在戰鬥回合解鎖它的所有層數。

lore_i18n.en: Wizards play an ancient yet mysterious role. Even though they mostly comprehend oracles and do minor entertaining tricks, Wizards are regarded as evil by many others because of the uncertainty of their purpose of action. The unique power Wizards possess awakes the inner potential of others, leading to a more united alliance.

lore_i18n.zh-cn: 巫师是一个古老而又神秘的职业，虽然他们从事的是传示神谕，解读魔术牌，玩弄戏法等一些类似的活动，巫师们还是因为装神弄鬼经常被人们与邪恶画上等号。
lore_i18n.zh-tw: 巫師是一個古老而又神秘的職業，雖然他們從事的是傳示神諭，解讀魔術牌，玩弄戲法等一些類似的活動，巫師們還是因為裝神弄鬼經常被人們與邪惡畫上等號。
